title: OrchestrationPatternRecord
description: A normalized record for a recurring architectural pattern in AI-native or workflow orchestration contexts. Derived from observation, not invented. Only add when a pattern is observed in 2+ independent sources.

description.description: What the pattern is and why it exists. Architecture-oriented — not a feature description.

observed_in.description: Where this pattern was observed. Minimum 2 independent sources to be included as a record.

maturity.description: theoretical=documented but not yet observed in production. emerging=observed in 2-3 places. established=consistent production pattern. production-standard=the expected approach.

requires.description: What this pattern requires to implement. Can reference tool IDs, skill IDs, or infrastructure types.

implementation_notes.description: Concrete guidance for implementing this pattern. Not generic — specific to the observed implementations.

anti_patterns.description: Common ways this pattern is incorrectly implemented.
